kind: Independent read-only F4 helper, hook and fixture review
observations: proofArchiveOutput.ts:19-31 retains the operator workspace-root alias, classifies output lexically and refuses static links below the physical workspace root. Explicit ordinary output outside the workspace remains supported at22-23 and60-63.

proofArchiveOutput.ts:33-46 admits only a regular single-link leaf, opens without O_TRUNC and with O_NOFOLLOW/O_NONBLOCK, checks fd/name device/inode and realpath; ftruncate is after these checks and Linux proc-fd inspection at50-53.
merkleIndexStore.ts:229-236 directs tar stdout to the admitted fd rather than reopening output by filename. Failure still throws and finally closes the fd.

transparencyProofExportContainment.test.ts:71-147 has genuine signed positive controls for internal/external/overwrite/new-parent/root-alias outputs and static linked-parent/linked-leaf/hardlink/nonfile refusals. The review did not rerun those tests.
limits: O_CREAT atproofArchiveOutput.ts:39 can create a new empty leaf before a later refusal; directory creation is also an observable effect. This is not an absolute no-effects guard.

A parent, inode or hardlink swap after checks is not atomically confined on either Linux or macOS. Linux proc-fd inspection adds evidence about the opened path; macOS has best-effort parent/name checks. No race witness was run in this read-only review.
Caller-selected external parent paths are resolved through realpathParent; refusal of all aliases outside the workspace is not the public library contract.
result: No actionable defect found within the declared static-link refusal and best-effort race scope.
